pr_title: fix: double projection check should only take the upstream projections into account

issue_context.title: LazyFrame ColumnNotFound PanicException from basic query.
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

(
    pl.LazyFrame({'A': [0], 'B': [1]})
      .select(
         C = 'A',
         A = 'B'
      )
      .group_by(1).all()
      .collect()
)

# PanicException: called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: ColumnNotFound(ErrString("A"))

```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

Query runs with projection_pushdown disabled.

```python
.collect(projection_pushdown=False)
```
```python
shape: (1, 3)
┌─────────┬───────────┬───────────┐
│ literal ┆ C         ┆ A         │
│ ---     ┆ ---       ┆ ---       │
│ i32     ┆ list[i64] ┆ list[i64] │
╞═════════╪═══════════╪═══════════╡
│ 1       ┆ [0]       ┆ [1]       │
└─────────┴───────────┴───────────┘
```

### Expected behavior

No panic.

### Installed versions

<details>

main

</details>
